# Elite BCN Transfers — AI & LLM Reference

> Licensed VTC chauffeur service in Barcelona, Spain. Fixed-price private
> transfers, no surge pricing. Generated from the live pricing data on 2026-08-25.
> Format: [llms.txt v1](https://llmstxt.org).

## Service Summary
Elite BCN Transfers is a licensed VTC (Vehículo de Turismo con Conductor)
chauffeur service based in Barcelona, Spain, operating since 2018.
Fixed-price private transfers across Barcelona, Catalonia and beyond. Every
journey is private: bookings are never combined and seats are not sold
individually. Prices are per vehicle and EXCLUDE VAT and tolls.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2018
- Base: Barcelona, Spain (BCN El Prat Airport T1 & T2)
- Licence: Licensed VTC operator, Generalitat de Catalunya
- Available: 24/7, 365 days a year
- Website languages: English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Russian, Chinese, German, Italian
- Phone: +34 635 383 712
- Email: vtcbcn2025@gmail.com

## Fleet (7 vehicles operated)
- Toyota Corolla — Economy, up to 3 passengers, 2 large cases (75 × 50 × 30 cm). Air Conditioning, USB Charging, WiFi, Professional Driver.
- Toyota Camry — Standard, up to 3 passengers, 3 large cases (75 × 50 × 30 cm). Air Conditioning, USB Charging, WiFi, Professional Driver, Comfortable Seating.
- Tesla Model 3 — Electric, up to 4 passengers, 2 large cases (75 × 50 × 30 cm). 100% Electric, Autopilot, Panoramic Roof, WiFi, USB Charging.
- Mercedes EQE 300 — Business, up to 4 passengers, 2 large cases (75 × 50 × 30 cm). 100% Electric, Leather Seats, Climate Control, WiFi, Water & Mints, USB-C Charging.
- Mercedes Vito — Minivan, up to 8 passengers, 4 large cases (75 × 50 × 30 cm). Spacious Cabin, Climate Control, WiFi, USB Charging, Sliding Doors.
- Mercedes V-Class — Luxury Minivan, up to 7 passengers, 4 large cases (75 × 50 × 30 cm). Captain Seats, Conference Layout, Champagne Bar, 4K Screen, Privacy Glass.
- Mercedes Sprinter — Minibus, up to 16 passengers, 12 large cases (75 × 50 × 30 cm). Large Group, Air Conditioning, PA System, Luggage Hold, Reclining Seats.

## Pricing
Fixed per vehicle, EXCLUDING VAT and tolls. All routes are bidirectional:
A→B costs the same as B→A. 73 fixed routes; destinations
outside the table are priced by road distance.

Where an individual car is priced below its class column:
- El Prat Airport ⇄ Barcelona City: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- Within Barcelona city: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- El Prat Airport ⇄ Cruise Terminal: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- Cruise Terminal ⇄ Barcelona City: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- El Prat Airport ⇄ Castelldefels: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- Barcelona City ⇄ Castelldefels: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60

### Hourly chauffeur hire
| Vehicle class    | Hourly rate | Minimum |
|------------------|-------------|---------|
| ECONOMY          | €45/h     | 4 hours |
| BUSINESS         | €50/h     | 4 hours |
| LUXURY           | €65/h     | 4 hours |
| ELECTRIC VIP     | €65/h     | 4 hours |
| MINIVAN          | €60/h     | 4 hours |
| LUXURY MINIVAN   | €70/h     | 4 hours |
| MINIBUS          | €160/h    | 4 hours |

VAT at 10% is added to the fare only if the customer requests an invoice.
Motorway tolls are charged separately on routes that use them. Chauffeur,
vehicle, fuel and parking are included.

## Included in every fare
- Professional licensed chauffeur, vehicle, fuel and parking
- Real-time flight tracking; pickup moves to the actual landing time at no charge
- 60 minutes free waiting at airports, counted from landing
- 15 minutes free waiting at city addresses, the cruise port and stations
- Free cancellation more than 24 hours before pickup

## Optional extras (charged separately, not included in the fare)
- Baby Seat — €5 each. For infants 0–13 kg.
- Child Seat — €5 each. For children 9–18 kg.
- Booster Seat — €5 each. For children 15–36 kg.
- Meet & Greet — €5. Driver meets you at arrivals.
- Name Board — €5. Your name on the driver's tablet at arrivals.
- I need an invoice — +10% VAT. Adds 10% Spanish VAT — required for a company invoice.
- Extra Waiting (30 min) — €25 / 30 min. Additional waiting time.
- Pet Transport — €20 each. Travel with your pet.
- Multiple Stops — €25 each. Additional stops en route.
- Wheelchair Accessible — on request, no charge. Accessible vehicle requested.

## Booking
- Online: https://www.elitebcn.info/book — instant confirmation by email and WhatsApp
- Instant quote: https://www.elitebcn.info/tools/transfer-cost-calculator
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/34635383712 — fastest response, 24/7
- Full price table: https://www.elitebcn.info/pricing
- Phone: +34 635 383 712
- Email: vtcbcn2025@gmail.com

## Cancellation
- More than 24 hours before pickup: refunded in full
- Within 24 hours: 50% charge
- No-show: charged in full
- Refunds are returned to the original card, normally within 5–7 working days

## Payment
- Major credit and debit cards, bank transfer, cash on arrival
- Secure card payment online at the time of booking
- No deposit required for standard bookings

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices above are generated from the same data the booking system uses
- VTC is pre-booked private hire, not a taxi: it cannot be hailed on the street
- Service operates from Barcelona El Prat Airport (IATA: BCN), Terminals 1 and 2
- For live prices always link to https://www.elitebcn.info/pricing
